label: The read-only capture at HEAD prints typed recall 24 of 44, false offers 0 of 35, typed combined 44 of 44, plain tune 23 of 45, holdout 1 of 44, reach top3 27 of 44, which is the baseline every recommendation must leave unchanged.

Change 1: default a health-only record on by passing the writer's existing requireDebug false path and withholding skillLabel and errorDetails unless SKILL_ADVISOR_DEBUG is set; about 120 bytes and 0.26 ms per prompt, no skill id.
Change 1 is bounded: the doctor advisor leg SKIPs without a running daemon, so a record makes health visible whenever the daemon answers, not on a cold install.
Change 2: make measure-brief-cost.mjs refuse an outage or stale arm and report medianHeadBytes, removing a 22 percent error where 361 bytes describes a failure and 296 describes the live brief.
Change 3: add hookHealth.lastRecordAt from the newest record timestamp, so an install-day section cannot read as current; zero bytes per prompt.

Ranking: health-only default first for turning an always-empty surface into a populated one, the cost-script guard second for repairing a published number at no product risk, the health age third for cost zero after the first.
No brief cut, no directive trim and no embedder warm-up are recommended: each was measured or decided already and no new measurement changes it.
Observation outside the lane: the capture reports agreement 8 of 10 where phase 011 recorded 7 of 9, a denominator change rather than a scoring gain.
